summary: The patch correctly keeps Remove-missing visible whenever saved identifiers are absent from the catalog, including an empty catalog, and adds a focused regression assertion.

evidence: static/admin.js:9385 now hides the control only when modelsMissingIds() is empty, so saved ids remain actionable with an empty catalog.
tests/admin-models-catalog.test.ts:729-735 adds a focused regression contract for the empty-catalog missing-id behavior.
